//: Declarative vicinae config, loaded via VICINAE_OVERRIDES in vicinae.service — highest priority, survives GUI writes to settings.json (which stays vicinae-owned and unmanaged, the cliamp lesson). A second, theme-generated overrides file rides after this one in the list.
//tray: Vicinae started shipping a StatusNotifier icon and turns it on by default. The bar's tray is for things with state worth watching; a launcher bound to a key has none, and its menu duplicates what the launcher already does.
//pop_to_root_on_close: FALSE since 2026-09-14, and the pair of launcher keybinds in niri's config.kdl depends on it. True made the launcher amnesiac in a way close_on_focus_loss turns into a daily cost: focusing any other window closes it, and closing with this true unwinds the whole view stack on the spot, so glancing at the browser mid-task threw the task away. False makes the close suspend the stack instead, Alt+Space reopens exactly what was on screen, and bin/vicinae-launch gives Mod+Space its fresh root back with an explicit popToRoot.

launcher_window.//size: The fallback only. bin/vicinae-serve derives the real size from the focused output before it execs the server and writes it to the vicinae-size.json fragment, which rides last in VICINAE_OVERRIDES and wins — these numbers are what a machine gets when niri cannot be asked. They are also the floor that derivation clamps to, being what the MacBook's 1706x1066 logical desktop works out to.

//favorites: Deliberately NOT set here, unlike every other root-list knob in this file. An overrides key replaces the array wholesale, so pinning favourites declaratively also *unpins* anything absent — which silently reverted the launcher's own Add/Remove Favorite action, and made clipboard:history reappear after every removal (2026-09-14). Favourites are the one part of the root list that is worth changing in the moment, from the item itself, so they stay vicinae-owned in settings.json. A fresh machine simply starts with none.
//fallbacks: What the root search offers when nothing matches what was typed — the only way an arbitrary phrase becomes a command. Empty since the switch because the stock entry was files:search and the files provider is off above. Order is what matters now that there are two: Tab (the ActivateFallback keybind from packages/vicinae-tab-fallback.patch) runs the FIRST entry, so vicinae/ai-ask:ask holds it and any typed phrase is a question answered in place, Raycast's Quick AI. vicinae/youtube:search stays second, still reachable by arrowing down to it. Ids are what `vicinae cmd ls` prints, and an id that does not resolve is ignored rather than fatal — so a machine mid-apply, with the extension not yet built, just has no fallback.
